content:
I've been on a constant search for ultra-thin accessories to complement my everyday carry (EDC), and I typically keep a close eye on just how thin major tech companies and brands can make their products. I tend to avoid accessories that are too thick or lack functionality. As a result, I've tried countless accessories, ranging from chargers, stands, magnetic cables, and everything in between. I want to share with you some of my top picks, accessories that are not only ultra-thin and portable but also packed with features and incredibly practical.

Be sure to check out my hands-on video, where I showcase all the devices mentioned and more! The video covers 11 small, slim accessories worth noting!

This is my latest addition to my EDC, and honestly, it's amazing. It's incredible how much functionality they've packed into something this thin. It's basically the same thickness as the camera bump on an iPhone. Here are its key features:

  • Features a PopSockets-like ring for single or double finger grip
  • Comes with a separate, adjustable metal stand that rotates 350 degrees
  • Supports both portrait and landscape viewing orientations
  • Magnetic on both sides, meaning you can stack additional MagSafe accessories on top of the stand

I still can't figure out how they managed to pack so much functionality into a stand that's this thin and light, but it's become a permanent fixture on my iPhone. It's so thin that you can even wireless charge with it attached! And because it's slim enough, it actually eliminates the wobble when you lay your phone flat on a table!

The Snap Grip Stand is available on their official website for $39.99 and comes in four colors: black, green, lilac, and silver. They also offer a ring-only version for $29.99, available in 18 colors (too many to count). This comes highly recommended for any iPhone user.

This is my absolute favorite. On the surface, it looks like just another 3-in-1 Apple product charger, but it's the build quality, features, and value that truly set it apart. You get:

  • A Qi2.2 25W MagSafe-compatible charger
  • A 5W Apple Watch charger
  • A 5W AirPods charger
  • A foldable CNC aluminum design

This thing is incredibly small, thin, and lightweight. The Kuxiu X40 Turbo can fold up to just charge your iPhone, unfold into a 3-in-1 charging stand, or lay completely flat. At its thinnest point, it's only 18mm, and when folded, it fits comfortably in the palm of your hand. Best of all, it even includes the 45W power adapter needed to support 25W fast charging, along with a hard-shell carrying case to keep everything together. This is truly an underrated product.

The Kuxiu X40 Turbo is available on the Kuxiu official website for $78 and comes in five colors: gray, black, wood grain, orange, and cherry. It's the first charger that perfectly matches the Cosmic Orange iPhone! At $78, you get the charger, a braided cable, a 45W power adapter, and a carrying case.

Now it gets even more interesting. I'm a huge proponent of ultra-slim magnetic chargers. High-capacity MagSafe chargers have their purpose, but if I want to charge my phone on the go, I'd rather bring along a smaller battery that can top off my phone without turning it into a two-pound brick. Currently, the thinnest and lightest MagSafe charger is the SolidSafe Air. You get:

  • 5,000mAh battery capacity
  • An ultra-thin 6.8mm profile
  • Qi2 wireless charging up to 15W
  • USB-C wired output up to 20W
  • The ability to charge two devices simultaneously

I have three of these chargers, and I carry one with me everywhere. My iPhone 17 Pro barely lasts a full day, so for me, having one of these on hand is a necessity. They're lightweight, feel premium, and come in several beautiful colors.

The SolidSafe Air 5K is available on the BMX official website for $59 and comes in three colors: black, silver, and gold. You can opt for a two-pack or three-pack bundle to save some money. My only request for the next generation would be to swap the LED indicator for a small display, as long as it doesn't add any thickness!

For iPhone photography enthusiasts, or anyone who enjoys traveling light but still wants adequate lighting, this is a pretty interesting product. The SnapPocket is a small, portable ring light that magnetically attaches to the back of your phone. It also flips over to provide excellent fill light when using the front-facing camera. You get:

  • 8 built-in LED lights
  • Brightness up to 90 lumens
  • Four levels of adjustable brightness
  • A rotatable, MagSafe-compatible design
  • A built-in rechargeable battery with USB-C charging

On paper, the SnapPocket is twice as bright as the iPhone's built-in flash and provides a more stable light source, which is particularly great for video recording. Like the other accessories, this one also prioritizes portability and compactness. It can fit into any pocket or bag, and because it supports MagSafe, it can stay attached to your phone at all times.

The ShiftCam SnapPocket Light is available on Amazon for $33 (using the promo code on the product page). It comes in three colors: black, blue, and gray. For anyone looking to enhance their iPhone photography experience without spending a lot of money or dealing with complicated gear, this is the perfect gift.

I've mentioned this product before, but I use it so frequently that I want to bring it up again. Everyone knows SSD prices have been getting ridiculous lately, but for the time being, buying an external SSD is still far more cost-effective than paying extra for high-capacity built-in storage on an iPhone. So when I want to record ProRes video, I always use my Lexar ES5 SSD. It magnetically attaches to the phone, features a built-in USB-C cable, and can record directly to the SSD without taking up any of the iPhone's storage. You get:

  • Read/write speeds up to 2,000MB/s
  • USB 3.2 Gen 2x2 connectivity
  • Support for direct ProRes video recording up to 4K/120fps
  • IP65 water and dust resistance rating with 3-meter drop protection
  • Capacity up to 4TB

The size is another reason I tend to choose this SSD over other brands. It's small and lightweight, and the slightly rounded edges make it more comfortable to hold when gripping the phone.

The Lexar ES5 is available on Amazon, starting at $199 for the 1TB version. Although it's a bit pricier than it was a few months ago, it's still significantly cheaper than buying an iPhone with 1TB of built-in storage.

Conclusion

As I mentioned above, be sure to check out my video, where I showcase 11 small, slim products that I'm confident readers will love. The five items above are just my top picks selected from the bunch. My philosophy is to keep everything as lightweight as possible, and these accessories fit that requirement perfectly. From the ultra-thin, multi-functional Snap Grip Stand to the incredibly practical Lexar SSD, they all get the job done without forcing me to lug around bulky accessories.

What do you all think of these products? Have you used any of them? What are your favorite accessories in this category? Let's discuss in the comments below!
